title: My Hero Academia Season 7
native: 僕のヒーローアカデミア 7
synopsis:
Following an all-out battle with the Paranormal Liberation Front, it is difficult for the people of Japan to continue placing faith in their heroes. To combat the combined power of Tomura Shigaraki and All For One, All Might calls for his ally from the West—the strongest woman on the planet, Star and Stripe.

However, All For One decides to intercept Star and her fleet to get his hands on her overpowered quirk before she can enter Japanese airspace. Although Endeavor, Hawks, and Best Jeanist are headed to the rendezvous point, Star makes a gamble in the present to save her comrades.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

Note: The season was preceded by a 4-episode special titled 'Boku no Hero Academia: Memories' recapping events from the 6th season along with adding a few minutes of new material each episode.

episodes.title: In the Nick of Time! A Big-Time Maverick from the West
episodes.synopsis:
As jailbreakers run rampant in Japan, Star and Stripe flies from the U.S. to Japan to help and finds Shigaraki waiting for her in the middle of her flight path.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Specter
episodes.synopsis:
The fight between Star and Stripe and Shigaraki is coming to an end, but Star has one more trick up her sleeve with New Order.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Villain
episodes.synopsis:
After failing to steal Star's Quirk, New Order, and losing many other Quirks, Shigaraki and All For One prepare for their next move. Who is the traitor at U.A.?!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Story of How We All Became Heroes
episodes.synopsis:
Due to his relationship with All For One, Yuga Aoyama calls himself a villain, but Deku tells him that he can still be a hero and reaches a hand out to him.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Let you down
episodes.synopsis:
As heroes and villains get ready for the coming battle, Deku and the others leave U.A. and Deku is called out by Aoyama, who is supposed to be in a police cell. What does Aoyama want?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Division
episodes.synopsis:
It's finally time for the decisive battle between heroes and villains! The plan by All Might, Aizawa, and the others has them start their fights in various places around Japan!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Inflation
episodes.synopsis:
Even though Shigaraki's Quirks are sealed, he attacks Bakugo and the others with a strange new appearance and power. Meanwhile, Deku is pulled to where Toga was warped and Todoroki and Dabi face off!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Two Flashfires
episodes.synopsis:
Eleven years ago, Toya Todoroki was burned by his own flames and became Dabi. Todoroki faces Dabi's blue flames with a new move of his own. Will he be able to stop his brother...?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Extras
episodes.synopsis:
Shoto Todoroki stopped Dabi with his Great Glacial Aegir, and reports of that bolstered the spirits of the heroes fighting in other locations. And Shoto and Dabi's father, Endeavor, is facing the greatest evil, All For One, with Hawks!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Wounded Hero, Burning Bright and True!!
episodes.synopsis:
Before the threat of All For One, Endeavor falls, and Hawks, Jiro, and Tokoyami are also cornered. Even so, Jiro acts like a hero! Endeavor is also encouraged after looking back at his own life.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Light Fades to Rain
episodes.synopsis:
Bakugo's Howitzer Impact didn't work against Shigaraki/All For One, either, and Bakugo is pushed into a corner by Shigaraki's power and words. In order to get him out of that predicament, U.A.'s Big Three take a stand!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Those Who Defend, Those Who Violate
episodes.synopsis:
Bakugo surprised Shigaraki/All For One with Cluster but was then cruelly pierced through. The heroes in all the different locations are getting pushed back... But even so, they will not give up!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: A Chain of Events, Across the Ages
episodes.synopsis:
Deku finally arrives at the Coffin in the Sky! Seeing Bakugo and the others defeated by Shigaraki/All For One, Deku shakes with anger. Can he control his feelings and win against Shigaraki? It's finally time for a showdown!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Together with Shoji
episodes.synopsis:
Spinner takes heteromorphs who are exploding with resentment from being persecuted to Central Hospital to get Kurogiri back. Shoji, whose Quirk also makes him a heteromorph, shouts his feelings to them.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Butterfly Effect
episodes.synopsis:
Spinner and Present Mic both yell their hearts out. Will the one waking up to their voices be Kurogiri or Shirakumo? Meanwhile, fighting Ochaco and the others on Okuto Island, Toga is finally going to use her secret weapon...!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Chain Thus Far
episodes.synopsis:
Toga consumed Twice's blood, and with Kurogiri's Warp, infinite doubles of Twice appear. Shigaraki's Decay is also released, and the heroes seem to be in a state of despair. But then, help comes from an unexpected quarter...

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Hopes
episodes.synopsis:
With the addition of Gentle, La Brava, and Lady Nagant, Deku is able to restrain Shigaraki's hands and confront him on the ground. Meanwhile, at the Gunga Villa site, the rewound All For One shows off his awful power...

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: It's a Small World!
episodes.synopsis:
Shishikura and the other members of Shiketsu High join the fight at the Gunga Villa site, and it's do-or-die as the heroes unite to fight back! But as All For One gets younger, he gets stronger. That's when unexpected backup arrives...!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: I Am Here
episodes.synopsis:
Trampling the heroes, All For One flies to become one with Shigaraki, and Dabi is about to explode with the heat he's been storing up in his body. Will the Symbol be able change this hopeless situation?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: A Girl's Ego
episodes.synopsis:
Toga transforms into Twice and backs the heroes into a corner with Infinite Doubles. In the midst of that, Ochaco does her best to get close to Toga to talk to her. How does Toga respond...?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Battle Without a Quirk
episodes.synopsis:
Toga returns the smile of Ochaco, who tried to befriend her. What does Toga do to the seriously injured Ochaco? Meanwhile, All Might uses "power" developed by a friend to face All For One!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
